**Observation Log:**

[FACT] User has made at least 10 purchases in the past month from different websites like Amazon, ASOS, and Zappos.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant mentioned keeping a physical notebook for order details, tracking numbers, and expected delivery dates.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested prioritizing and categorizing orders by type or priority.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advised checking accounts regularly to ensure no important updates are missed.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant mentioned considering a virtual assistant like Google Assistant, Siri, or Alexa for reminders.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended reviewing and adjusting the organization system at the end of each month.

[PREFERENCE] User likes the spreadsheet idea for tracking orders.
